tldr: Venus in Leo: love is warm, expressive, and generous with the heart.
body: With Venus in Leo, affection wants joy, celebration, romance, and visible appreciation. You value love that feels alive, proud, and creative.
gift: Generosity, charisma, playfulness, and radiant affection.
challenge: Drama, vanity, and needing admiration to believe love is present.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
